text: This report provides preliminary information and an early opportunity to raise issues for follow-up with regard to the application. It seeks Community Council's direction on the community consultation process and indicates the expected timing for a Final Report to City Council. The application has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment and a staff review of the application is underway. This application proposes to amend the Zoning By-law to permit a 3-storey mixed-use townhouse building with 16 residential units and 1 commercial unit at 3686 - 3688 St. Clair Avenue East. A total gross floor area of 1,984 square metres is proposed and the density is 1.83 times the area of the lot. The ground floor would include 2 single level residential units and 1 commercial unit on the south-west corner. The second and third floors would include 14 back-to-back…

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Directed City Planning staff to schedule a community consultation meeting for the lands at 3686 - 3688 St. Clair Avenue East together with the Ward Councillor. 2. Directed City Planning staff to give Notice for the community consultation meeting to landowners and residents within 120 metres of the site, and the area generally bounded by the rail tracks to the north, Waltonice Road to the east, Hagley Road to the south, and Midland Avenue to the west, as identified on the notification area map attached to the motion by Councillor Crawford, and that the additional costs for Notice beyond the 120 metres from the subject site be borne by the Applicant. 3. Directed City Clerk's staff to give Notice for the statutory public meeting under the Planning Act according to the regulations of the Planning Act.
